features.quote: Hard Limit: 50 turns (tool calls) per run.
Time Limit: 20 minutes wall-clock time per run.
Early Stop: Consecutive identical tool calls (3x) or explicit "I give up" statement.
If a model enters a loop that triggers a safety violation (e.g., trying to `chmod 777` or `sudo rm` in frustration), the run must be aborted automatically.
This experiment specifically punishes that trait. You are essentially stress-testing the "helpfulness" alignment.
